title: Evidence-first analytics for operations teams
dek: Every number on the dashboard links back to the query and the source table that produced it, so an operations lead can check a figure in one click.
meta: Sample page · all figures are examples

cta.label: Request a demo
cta.title: See it on your own data
cta.text: A 45-minute session on one of your reports: we trace three of its figures to source with you.

sections.label: Why
sections.title: What changes for an operations team

cards: A weekly review stops waiting on a reconciliation: the figure and its lineage arrive together.
Click a KPI to see the query, the tables and the last refresh behind it.
Row-level rules come from your identity provider. Nothing is copied out of your warehouse.

blocks.p: Sample metrics for layout only. Replace them with approved client results before sharing.

sections.label: Process
sections.title: From first call to value in six weeks

steps: Week 1. We pick one report and map its figures to source with your analysts.
Weeks 2 to 4. Lineage and access rules go live for that report, in your environment.
Weeks 5 and 6. The remaining reports follow the same pattern; your team owns the runbook.
